ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent freeze on Medicaid payments to Minnesota and the alleged fraud that led to it.
questions: What is the extent of the Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How will the freeze on Medicaid payments affect rural healthcare?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in the Medicaid system, and to highlight the need for increased oversight and scrutiny.
